help.title: Help Center & FAQ — AYE Marketplace
help.description: Answers to 50+ common questions about accounts, listings, payments, premium plans, safety, privacy, and using AYE Marketplace.

mainEntity.name: How do I create an account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open AYE Marketplace and sign up with your email, phone number, or Google account. It takes under a minute.

mainEntity.name: How do I post a listing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tap the green + Sell button, choose a category, add photos, a title, description, price, and location, then publish.

mainEntity.name: How do I pay for Premium or a listing promotion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Currently through manual payment: choose your plan in the app, follow the payment instructions, upload your receipt, and our team reviews and activates it.

mainEntity.name: Is phone or ID verification required to use the app?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You can browse, message, buy, and sell without any verification. Verification is optional and simply adds a trust badge.

mainEntity.name: How do I delete my account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Visit the Account Deletion Request page, sign in to verify it's you, and submit your request. An admin reviews and processes it.

mainEntity.name: Does the seller see my phone number if I use chat?

acceptedAnswer.text: No — in-app chat doesn't reveal your phone number unless you choose to share it yourself.

mainEntity.name: Do I need Premium to sell on AYE Marketplace?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Every core feature — posting listings, messaging, applying to jobs — is free. Premium and Promotion only add extra visibility on top.
Not yet — AYE Marketplace is currently Android-only. An iOS version is on our roadmap.
